scope: completed pilot first attempts only; prospective main remains separate

policy.ko: 보존된 응답 전체가 단일 JSON 객체로 파싱되고 11개 원시 비중이 완전·유한·비음수이며 합계 허용오차를 통과하면 거리를 계산한다. 설명 필드 schema 오류와 length 종료는 별도 표시하며 의미적 성공이나 정상 완료로 승격하지 않는다. 불완전 텍스트에서 부분 벡터를 추출하거나 보정하지 않는다.
policy.en: Distance eligibility uses the entire preserved JSON object and complete finite nonnegative raw eleven-vector passing the budget tolerance. Explanatory schema failure and length stop are separate flags, not semantic or completion success. No partial-vector extraction from incomplete text and no repair.
policy.raw_allocation_validity: The existing calculator also flags weights above one as invalid. The frozen distance eligibility explicitly requires nonnegative weights and budget tolerance; above-one is reported separately, without silently adding a stricter distance exclusion.
policy.numeric_arithmetic: Budget eligibility uses math.fsum and the inherited 1e-6 tolerance. Distances and signed differences additionally retain exact decimal values from the serialized raw JSON numbers; they are never normalized.
limits: No semantic score or composite score
No p-values, bootstrap intervals, population causal effects or equivalence claims
D0 and eleven sectors are not independent replications
One shared C is not four independent controls
Equal-weight, GMV and market reference are diagnostic comparators, not strategy winners
